Site URL: The original web address submitted for analysis.
site_id: The id of the domain in the csv file that lists the sites to crawl (zero indexed). Used for processing, e.g., to identify domains that redirect to another domain.
status: Shows whether the website was successfully scanned during the crawl.
domain: The domain name of the site that was analyzed. Note that the domain may be different than the site provided for the crawl if a redirect occurs.
sent_gpc: A binary indicator of whether the OptMeowt Analysis extension sent a GPC opt out signal to the site.
gpp_version: The version of the CMP API that obtains the GPP string (e.g., v1.0 has a getGPPdata command, which v1.1 removes in favor of callback functions).
uspapi_before_gpc: Return value of calling the USPAPI before a GPC opt out signal is sent.
uspapi_after_gpc: Return value of calling the USPAPI after a GPC opt out signal was sent.
usp_cookies_before_gpc: The value of the US Privacy string in an HTTP cookie before a GPC opt out signal is sent.
usp_cookies_after_gpc: The value of the US Privacy string in an HTTP cookie after a GPC opt out signal was sent.
OptanonConsent_before_gpc: The isGpcEnabled value from OneTrust's OptanonConsent cookie before a GPC opt out signal is sent. isGpcEnabled=1 means opted out; isGpcEnabled=0 means not opted out. If the cookie has no isGpcEnabled value, we return "no_gpc".
OptanonConsent_after_gpc: The isGpcEnabled value from OneTrust's OptanonConsent cookie after a GPC opt out signal was sent. isGpcEnabled=1 means opted out; isGpcEnabled=0 means not opted out. If the cookie has no isGpcEnabled value, we return "no_gpc".
gpp_before_gpc: The value of the GPP string before a GPC opt out signal is sent.
gpp_after_gpc: The value of the GPP string after a GPC opt out signal was sent.
urlClassification: Return value of Firefox's urlClassification object, sorted by category and filtered for: fingerprinting, tracking_ad, tracking_social, any_basic_tracking, any_social_tracking.
OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut_before_gpc: The value of the OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut cookie before a GPC signal is sent. This cookie is described by OneTrust.
OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut_after_gpc: The value of the OneTrustWPCCPAGoogleOptOut cookie after a GPC signal was sent. This cookie is described by OneTrust.
OTGPPConsent_before_gpc: The value of the OTGPPConsent cookie before a GPC signal is sent. This cookie is described by OneTrust.
OTGPPConsent_after_gpc: The value of the OTGPPConsent cookie after a GPC signal was sent. This cookie is described by OneTrust.
usps_before_gpc: The US Privacy string recorded before a GPC opt out signal is sent.
usps_after_gpc: The US Privacy string recorded after a GPC opt out signal was sent.
decoded_gpp_before_gpc: The GPP string before a GPC opt out signal is sent, decoded into a human-readable format.
decoded_gpp_after_gpc: The GPP string after a GPC opt out signal was sent, decoded into a human-readable format.
USPS implementation: How the site implements the US Privacy string: via the client-side JavaScript USPAPI, an HTTP cookie that stores its value, or both.
error: Error logged when a site could not be analyzed, e.g., TimeoutError (no load or response in 30 seconds), HumanCheckError (blocked VPN IP or captcha), InsecureCertificateError, WebDriverError, or UnexpectedAlertOpenError.
Well-known: Result of the well-known crawl of the site's .well-known/gpc.json file. It is non-conclusive for making a Compliance Classification.
compliance_result: Overall result based on the Compliance Classifications: Likely Honors GPC, Likely Does Not Honor GPC, or Not Applicable/Invalid/Missing.
compliance_classification: Breakdown of site compliance according to each specific method of possible opt outs (e.g., USPS, OptanonConsent Cookie, or GPP SaleOptOut field).
site_isnull: A boolean indicating if a site has no privacy strings, cookies, or GPP data detected before or after sending a GPC signal.
reasons_non_compliant: Specific reasons why the site was evaluated as non-compliant after receiving GPC.
Tranco: Website popularity ranking based on global web traffic (lower numbers indicate higher traffic). Data is from 2023.
third_party_count: Total count of external third-party domains loaded by the website. Crawls before July 2026 undercount this value.
third_party_urls: List of external web addresses loaded on the page. Crawls before July 2026 undercount this list.
unique_ad_networks: Names of distinct advertising networks detected on the page.
num_unique_ad_networks: Total number of distinct advertising networks found on the site.
